package.name: sim_supervisor
package.description:
sim_supervisor_node — simulates the role the IFS-08 uDV (microcontroller, microROS endpoint) plays on the real car. In sim it sources the GO signal, sinks the FINISHED signal, and is the DVPC-side action endpoint that mission_control_backend (web) targets through StartMission. On the real car this node does not run; the physical uDV plays that role instead.
See docs/autonomy_pipeline.md §"End-to-end graph" and §"Runtime action protocol" for the full diagram and the two-phase action contract this node implements.
